ننخفض (form VII)
# نَنْخَفِضُ (nanḵafiḍu) /nan.xa.fi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# نَنْخَفِضَ (nanḵafiḍa) /nan.xa.fi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# نَنْخَفِضْ (nanḵafiḍ) /nan.xa.fidˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
